en: Someday you'll go back to the tower, won't you...
Yeah... I guess...{wait}{clear}Hey, let's drop that. We've talked plenty already.
Is there anything else?
You're worried about me. Thank you.{wait}{clear}But if this little tired me out, I couldn't do anything, could I? I'm fine.
Yes, of course.{wait}{clear}Though walking side by side with you feels a little strange.
Yes. It feels wonderful...{wait}{clear}To think you can fly through wind like this... I envy you a little.
Yes, I'll be fine. However rough the road, I'll make it through.{wait}{clear}Besides, if I kept avoiding rough roads, I'd never reach my destination, would I?
I do sometimes lose my way if I'm caught in the rain in an unfamiliar forest.{wait}{clear}But usually I reach my destination. So don't worry.
I never noticed until you said so. How sad...{wait}{clear}If I could fly through the sky like you, would I have noticed this beauty...?
Yes. Traveling with you like this, I've seen so many landscapes...{wait}{clear}There's still so much beautiful scenery... To realize only now that I must protect it... perhaps it's a little late...
Yes, very much.{wait}{clear}They help me when I'm in trouble. Just like you.
Yes...{wait}{clear}Away from the Empire, meeting people in towns and villages, I feel I finally understand what I must do...{wait}{clear}It isn't too late yet, is it...?
I can't think so... If I weren't wearing this uniform, it might have been more fun...{wait}{clear}I know it's impossible to ask people to understand the Empire as it is now... But someday, surely...
Thank you. I hope you have sweet dreams too.
Yes. But isn't it always hard on you too? You needn't worry about me, so go home and rest soon.

You ask strange things, as always. But yes... I don't think I dislike it.{wait}{clear}Before, I always felt as if something was driving me into a corner...{wait}{clear}This is no time to relax, even now, but I feel something inside me has changed.
Yes, I'll do that...
I always pray before going to sleep, to give thanks to my father and mother.{wait}{clear}I've never missed it since I was little, so it's truly a habit.
At first I wasn't good at it. But on campaigns, you can't afford to say that, can you?{wait}{clear}So now it doesn't bother me. Besides, if I couldn't sleep, my sword would grow dull.
These days I think about many things. Memories of my parents, the Empire... and the battles to come...{wait}{clear}But my swordsmanship would dull, so I make myself sleep as best I can.
Yes... I've never forgotten it...{wait}{clear}Perhaps I think about it all the more because of how things are, and because I'm so far away.{wait}{clear}Even though I may never be able to go back...
Yes, I don't mind, but...

You do wonder about strange things, as always. Well, very well...{wait}{clear}Let me see... I breathe deeply and calm my mind, I suppose.{wait}{clear}It's important to do it in the morning. A restless spirit breeds hesitation...
Of course.{wait}{clear}I've only just begun, and if I stopped at this, it wouldn't be training, would it?{wait}{clear}The fighting is far from over. I can't let my sword grow dull.
What's the matter? You needn't worry about me so oddly.{wait}{clear}Besides, when I'm moving, I don't have to think about anything. It's easier.

Compared to my training to become a knight, my training now is not hard at all.{wait}{clear}Besides, if I said such things, you can easily imagine what kind of situation I'd end up in, can't you?{wait}{clear}I can't afford to lose... And for that, I can't lose to myself either.
Are you worried about me? Hehehe... You're always so considerate.{wait}{clear}But don't worry, I won't overdo it. I'll rest when I'm tired. I believe I know myself well when I train.
When I swing my sword with an empty mind, I feel I can forget unpleasant things...{wait}{clear}Just like when I was a child.

You always seem to wonder about strange things.{wait}{clear}How could anyone serve as a knight without confidence in their stamina?{wait}{clear}Besides, for a woman like me aiming for the top, having no stamina would be out of the question.
You're such a worrier. But I'm fine, so rest easy.{wait}{clear}If I got hurt in training, not even a real match, I'd have no business going into battle.
Let me see... I focus on how to refine my technique.{wait}{clear}And on the meaning of wielding a sword...{wait}{clear}I always try to remember that I don't fight just to kill people.
It's going well.{wait}{clear}At this rate, I should be able to answer your requests well enough, so rest easy.
Yes. Without results, it can be hard to stay motivated.{wait}{clear}But I think blindly chasing results alone is no good.{wait}{clear}If you lose sight of what's important, it means nothing...
You came because you needed something, didn't you? Why be so considerate?
What a question, just like you.{wait}{clear}I love the tension of learning swordsmanship and of fencing matches.{wait}{clear}A sword that refines oneself, not one that hurts people...
Yes.{wait}{clear}Even just gazing outside for a while, doing nothing, can calm the heart...

Hehehe... What an abrupt question...{wait}{clear}My father was my playmate. I only liked boys' games, so he taught me all sorts of things.{wait}{clear}Swordsmanship... horseback riding...{wait}{clear}But I think he wished I'd play a little more like a girl...
What is it? Do you have a little time to relax? Then let's take it easy. Since we have the chance...
Yes, I know. But rest is necessary, so let me take it easy, just for now...{wait}{clear}Then let's fight together again.
Thank you.{wait}{clear}But never mind me. You should rest when you can, too.
Yes... I think about many things, but before I know it, I seem to keep coming back to the same ones.
As an imperial knight, I attended many ceremonies and escort duties...{wait}{clear}Even that feels like a very long time ago now...
Thank you. I'm eating properly.{wait}{clear}It would be a problem if I had no strength when it counts.{wait}{clear}Besides, since leaving the Empire, I've been able to eat at a leisurely pace.
Yes... I know. Don't worry.
I'm fine. Don't make that face. Rest easy.
Thank you. I'm fine... I know...
Yes, I'm fine...
Worrying now won't get us anywhere, will it? I'll just go into battle without letting my guard down.
Yes... I understand...
Don't worry so much. I won't let my guard down against any enemy.
I'm sure you'll be fine, Leyla.
Yes... Thank you. But I won't let my guard down.
Don't say it with such a worried face. I'll be fine.
I'm fine. I know you're worried, but what good is it if you can't stay calm?
No, this is because I wasn't strong enough. I'm sorry I'm so pathetic...
Yes, I'm fine. But I'm sorry it came to this.
I know how you feel, but hearing that only makes me feel more pathetic...{wait}{clear}Next time, I'll live up to your expectations...
It's all right, don't worry. It's my own fault I was wounded...
It's all right, I don't need anything.{wait}{clear}Just stay by my side a little while... Having you here calms me, somehow...
Don't worry. I overestimated my own strength...{wait}{clear}It's shameful for a knight...
It's all right. Don't worry.{wait}{clear}Being relied on makes me happy. And unless I push myself to some degree, I can't go any further.
It's my fault I couldn't size up the enemy's strength...{wait}{clear}It was a good lesson...
Even an angel like you says harsh things...{wait}{clear}But if I were in your position, I'm sure I'd say the same.{wait}{clear}I was like that, back in the Empire...
...I'm sorry. I'm always making you worry.{wait}{clear}Once these wounds heal, I'll take your requests again.
The Empire
What kind of country is the Grosain Empire?
Our country... has a very long history and tradition. Its people take pride in that, and so do I...{wait}{clear}But now something has begun to go wrong... Because of that father and son...
The cause of the world's turmoil...
The Empire tormenting innocent people... I can't bear it...{wait}{clear}But... something else is...
If peace returns to this world... surely...
